For security vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md privately. Do not include dashboard keys, tokens, cookies, private telemetry or production configuration.

## Component and version

Dashboard / API / Live / Hub / documentation; exact commit or immutable artifact. If relevant, OS and executor. State whether this is local, hosted, mocked or native.

## Reproduction

Minimal steps, expected behavior and observed behavior.

## Evidence

Redacted errors or a synthetic fixture; checks already performed. Check screenshots for visible credentials before attaching.
